In this regard, the Petitioner has placed reliance on certain judicial pronouncements to substantiate its submissions. The Hon’ble Supreme Court in the case of _KSEB vs. Livisha_ has held that erection of transmission lines does not amount to land acquisition and that compensation is limited to the diminution in land value. In the case of _PGCIL vs. Century Textiles_ , the Apex Hon`ble Supreme Court reiterated that compensation for transmission line works is governed by the Central Guidelines and that disputes regarding compensation must be raised before the appropriate civil court. The Hon’ble Allahabad High Court in the case of _Akhtar Hasan_ has held that the transmission works cannot be halted due to pending compensation issues.
